scope: Public-release data-construction audit; no PLM inference or original-cohort replication.
known_positive_reference: All eligible human TRB MHCI canonical sequence exact two-field-HLA records, score >=0; exact beta/peptide/HLA triples and beta/peptide pairs (any HLA) separately.
identity_oracle: Resubstitution diagnostic of category class marginals on the same generated dataset, not predictive generalization.
uncertainty: Variation across negative-sampler RNG seeds; not biological or population confidence intervals.
order_rng: numpy.default_rng(100000+seed), separate from source collator Python random.Random(seed); global fallback pool preserves fixed source order regardless of loader order.

retention.algorithm: Minimum-cost full assignment allowing diagonal abstention, independently within each HLA; maximum cardinality closed subset of rows admitting a known-positive-excluding permutation.
